name: Ask an open question
short_description: Ask one question that invites more than a yes-or-no answer in an ordinary conversation.
self_assessment: I can ask one open question without help and allow the other person time to answer.
description: Ask one question that invites more than a yes-or-no answer in an ordinary conversation. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Ask what someone thought about an event

builds_on.note: Clear question structure supports reciprocal conversation.
